label: The Phantom Thief of Best Seller
notes: Favorite item quest step: Go to the Ark

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: *Sigh...*
So where to next?

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: I was wondering the same thing.
You don't look too happy.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Indeed...

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: My missing mask is one thing,

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: but I can't help feeling I was wrong to suspect everyone.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: And despite that, they've all offered to help me.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: This has nothing to do with the phantom thieves, yet I've ended up involving them regardless. That sits rather uneasily with me.
What are you talking about?
It doesn't matter whether it's related to phantom thieves or not.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: They're all just going about their daily lives, aren't they?
Being a phantom thief is part of their daily lives too.
Just because they're not wearing their outfits doesn't mean they're not the Thieves of Justice.
Actually, now that I think about it, we might be looking at this the wrong way.
Where did you leave that mask you lost?

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: I put it in a box and stored it in the workroom.
Your workroom?

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Yes... Wait, no, that's not quite right.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: It's my workroom when I'm not a phantom thief.
Phantom.
You don't have to separate your phantom thief side from the rest of who you are.
Just look at Delta, Miranda, and Quency.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Once I've sorted these books, that'll be it for today.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Phew... I'm getting a little tired.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Hm?

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: "The Mask of Phantom Thief P"?

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: I've never come across this one before.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: It looks like a novel.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Maybe I'll sit down and give it a read once I'm finished here.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: The Phantom Thief P...

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Despite the hardships of everyday life, there's a freer side to them.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: And it's that freedom that helps them endure it all.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Hmm... Perhaps I should read a few other phantom thief novels as well.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: I think I finally understand phantom thieves a little better now.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: They use their freedom to carry out justice from the shadows.
Phantom looks around the workroom.
Signs of long hours spent on something are everywhere,
but she can't remember a thing.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: It's almost as though...

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: they're no different from me!

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: All right, it's a little rough around the edges, but...!

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: With this mask, I can be a phantom thief too.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: I'll help everyone from the shadows,

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: and my daily life will become a little more colorful.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: ... Because this time, I'll remember every act of justice I've carried out.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: You're right.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Somewhere along the way, I'd forgotten.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: I am the phantom thief, and the phantom thief is me.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: The phantom thief exists because I do,

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: and because the Phantom Thief exists, so do I.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: That mask...

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Perhaps it wasn't stolen by someone targeting the phantom thief after all.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: It may simply be that I've lost it.
So are you going to give up?

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: I'm simply letting it go.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: It's also a way to punish myself for losing sight of my original resolve.
Still, you never know.
Let's check one more time.
I'll help you.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: I-if you say so.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Then I suppose there's no helping it.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: We'll have to go to my workroom.
Uh... Is it okay if I go with you?

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: You were the one who said

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: there was no need to separate my phantom thief side from my everyday self, were you not?

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: In that case, I shall extend a special invitation to you.
I follow Phantom into the familiar library.
We come to a stop in front of a metal door we've passed through before.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Monsieur...

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Is there nothing you wish to ask?
Nah... I think I'm past the point of being surprised.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Hehe, I see.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: It seems you'd already seen through my disguise.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: As always, you continue to surpass my expectations.
*Beep, beep*
*Clunk! Creeeak...*
The metal door opens, revealing Phantom's workroom.
Wow, it's so clean in here.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Clean...?

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Ah.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Aaagh!
Wh-what's wrong?!

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: I-I completely forgot today was the big clean-up...!

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: I became so caught up in my excitement that I rushed out of the library!

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: I-it seems Arcana and Label have already tidied everything up...!
Oh...

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: This can't be...

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: H-how am I supposed to apologize...?!
Hang on.
There's a note on your desk.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: A note...?
*Rustle*
"We heard you shout and run out, and since you never came back, we went ahead and took care of all the cleaning."
"We're not really sure what it is, but we found it while we were cleaning."
"Is this what you're looking for?"
Phantom picks up the book "The Phantom Thief P's Mask," which lies beside the note.
*Thump*
Something slips out from between the pages.
It's an old paper mask,
badly crumpled with age.
Even so, it's obvious someone put their heart into making it.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Ah...

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Now I remember.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: I wanted to keep it somewhere safe, so I tucked it into this book.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: ... So this is where it was all along.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: I don't know how I can ever thank the two of them.
*Whoosh! Tap!*

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Nin-nin.
Delta?

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Good evening.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: I found something similar to what you were looking for.
Delta holds out a scary-looking black mask to Phantom.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Wh-what's that?

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: A mask.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Unlike your mask, this one covers the entire face,

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: but I brought it here just in case.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: I had to recover it from the Observatory in a hurry, so it's not in good condition.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: D-don't tell me... you actually went all the way to the surface?
*Clunk!*

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: All hail the great phantom thief!
Quency?

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: Hehe, you've got more company than I expected.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: How did you...?

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: I was worried, so I went looking around and found something that looked close enough. Figured I'd bring it back for you.

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: What do you think?
Quency pulls out a plastic mask.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: H-how did you...?

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: I asked around and did some digging myself,

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: then somebody finally said they'd seen something like it.

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: You got any idea how many bottle caps that little tip cost me?

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: Anyway, turns out there really was a mask.

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: Figured it might be the one you're looking for, so I grabbed it for you.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Y-you used your precious resources... for this mask...?
*Whirr*
*Tap, tap, tap*

lines.speaker: miranda_c
lines.text: Hello, Phantom!

lines.speaker: miranda_c
lines.text: Were you able to find your mask?
Looks like everyone's here.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: ... So you found a mask too, Miranda?

lines.speaker: miranda_c
lines.text: Yeah, that's right!

lines.speaker: miranda_c
lines.text: I looked all over for it and found a similar one!

lines.speaker: miranda_c
lines.text: Will you take a look?
Miranda hands over a child-sized animal mask.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: This...

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Where did you find it...?

lines.speaker: miranda_c
lines.text: I found it while searching the park!

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: ... What would you have done if you hadn't found anything?

lines.speaker: miranda_c
lines.text: Then I would've kept searching!

lines.speaker: miranda_c
lines.text: Helping civilians recover their lost belongings is part of my job!

lines.speaker: miranda_c
lines.text: And if they're your belongings, Phantom, then I have to try even harder!
Phantom stares at the four masks before her, looking as though she's about to cry.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: What... What on earth has happened?
The phantom thieves went into action.
They found your lost item.
Somehow, though, instead of getting one back, you ended up with four.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Ohh...

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: I see...

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: They carried out justice from the shadows,

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: and once again,

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: it was the phantom thieves who saved me.
Phantom removes her mask,
hugs the book "The Phantom Thief P's Mask" to her chest,
then picks up the four masks laid out in front of her.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Monsieur!

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: How do I look?
You look part librarian, part phantom thief.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: So, in other words...

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: You're saying I look Phantom?

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Then who might you all be?
Phantom calls out to us with a smile.
Everyone exchanges uneasy glances.
I step forward and raise my voice.
... I'm {AccountData.NickName}, the Phantom Commander.
I protect humanity...
and I provide the phantom thieves with a hideout!

lines.speaker: miranda_c
lines.text: Aha!

lines.speaker: miranda_c
lines.text: I'm Miranda, the Phantom Police!

lines.speaker: miranda_c
lines.text: I protect civilians

lines.speaker: miranda_c
lines.text: and fight for justice!

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: Heh! So this is what we're doing?

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: I'm Quency, the Phantom Prisoner!

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: I live life on my own terms, and as Phantom's assistant, I make sure there's always a way through.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: I'm Delta from the Scouts, and also the trainee ninja thief.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Come to me if you ever need someone to perform observation or reconnaissance for you.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: And I'm working hard to become an official phantom thief.
Phantom looks at each of us in turn with a deeply moved expression.
So...
Who's standing in front of me?

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: I uphold justice from the shadows!

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: I am Phantom, the Phantom Librarian.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: I became a librarian because I love books,

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: and a phantom thief because I believe in doing what's right.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: ... Only now have I come to realise this simple truth.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: I know it's rather late, but...

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Would you allow me to remain by your side from here on?
We nod vigorously.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Haha...! Hahaha!

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Hahahaha!
Phantom laughs with an expression I've never seen her wear before.
... I wonder if she wore that same expression the day she first put on that mask and decided to become a phantom thief.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: It seems the sun is beginning to rise,

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: as light starts to seep into the library.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: ... As the shadows recede, the world begins to stir from its slumber.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Those who once danced beneath the stars slip back to their rightful places.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: As though nothing ever occurred, the day begins anew.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: But I shall no longer distinguish between day and night.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Through every hour,

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: I shall exist.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Tell me, how did you all know I was the Phantom Librarian?

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: Took you long enough to ask.

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: Are you starting to get a sense of how sloppy you've been?

lines.speaker: miranda_c
lines.text: Wait, there's a librarian Phantom too?

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: I simply followed your trail. That's all.
Oh...
Fortunately, it seems the Phantom Librarian's secret is safe for a little while longer.
